input: Create a custom playlist for my morning commute

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The length of the commute directly determines how long the playlist needs to be — a 15-minute drive needs a very different playlist than a 90-minute train ride.
The desired mood or energy level (e.g., pump-up and energetic vs. calm and focused) is the single biggest driver of which genres and tracks to include.
Knowing which genres or artists the user already loves narrows the universe of tracks from millions to a relevant shortlist.
Whether the playlist is just for the user or shared with others (e.g., a carpool) affects content choices, explicitness, and variety.
The commute mode (driving, train, walking, cycling) affects whether lyrics are distracting, whether tempo should match movement, and headphone vs. speaker use.
The streaming platform (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, etc.) determines the exact format of the deliverable — a shareable link, a track list, or step-by-step setup instructions.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — e.g., no repeated artists, a strong opening track, a gradual energy build — ensures the final playlist actually satisfies the user.

gold.taskTitle: Build a Custom Morning Commute Playlist
gold.taskDescription: Create a personalized music playlist tailored to the user's morning commute experience.

questions.title: How long is your morning commute in minutes?
questions.description: Determines the total duration and number of tracks needed for the playlist.

questions.title: What energy or mood do you want the playlist to create?
questions.description: Identifies whether the user wants to feel energized, calm, focused, happy, or something else entirely.

questions.title: Which genres or artists are you already a fan of?
questions.description: Anchors the track selection to music the user genuinely enjoys.

questions.title: Will you be listening alone or with other people?
questions.description: Determines whether the playlist needs to suit multiple tastes or can be fully personalized.

questions.title: How do you commute — car, train, bike, or walking?
questions.description: Shapes tempo choices, lyric complexity, and whether audio is via headphones or speakers.

questions.title: Which music app or platform do you use for listening?
questions.description: Determines the format of the output — a Spotify link, Apple Music playlist, a simple track list, etc.

questions.title: What would make this playlist feel perfect to you?
questions.description: Captures specific personal rules or must-haves, such as no repeating artists, a gradual energy build, or a specific opening track.
